solution: Tax collected = tax rate × consumption: 0.7 × 1.5 = 1.05, a 5% increase.
questionHi: कोयले पर कर 30% घटाया जाता है और इससे उसकी खपत 50% बढ़ जाती है। उस पर वसूले गए कर में क्या परिवर्तन होता है?
solutionHi: वसूला गया कर = कर की दर × खपत: 0.7 × 1.5 = 1.05, यानी 5% वृद्धि।

question: A's salary is 40% more than B's, and B's is 25% more than C's. A's salary is ₹9,000 more than C's. What is A's salary?
solution: Take C's = 100. B's = 125 and A's = 175, so A's exceeds C's by 75 per 100 of C's. C's = 9,000 ÷ 0.75 = ₹12,000, and A's = ₹21,000.

question: A family used to buy 25 litres of milk a month. Its price rises by 40%, and the family lets its spending on milk rise by only 12%. How many litres does it buy now?
solution: Quantity = spending ÷ price, so it becomes 25 × 1.12 ÷ 1.4 = 20 litres.
questionHi: एक परिवार हर महीने 25 लीटर दूध खरीदता था। उसका मूल्य 40% बढ़ता है, और परिवार उस पर अपना खर्च केवल 12% बढ़ने देता है। अब वह कितने लीटर खरीदता है?
solutionHi: मात्रा = खर्च ÷ मूल्य, अतः यह 25 × 1.12 ÷ 1.4 = 20 लीटर हो जाती है।

question: A rent is increased by 25% and the new rent is then decreased by 25%. It ends up ₹500 less than at first. What was it at first?
solution: An increase and a decrease of 25% leave 1.25 × 0.75 = 0.9375, a loss of 6.25%. So 6.25% of the value is 500: value = 500 ÷ 0.0625 = ₹8,000.

question: A machine's speed is cut by 20% and then by a further 25%. By what percentage must it now be raised to bring it back to where it began?
solution: After the cuts it is 0.8 × 0.75 = 0.6 of the start. To get back it must be multiplied by 1 ÷ 0.6, an increase of 66⅔%.
questionHi: एक मशीन की गति पहले 20% और फिर 25% और घटाई जाती है। अब इसे कितने प्रतिशत बढ़ाया जाए कि यह शुरुआत जितनी हो जाए?

question: A bus driver increases the speed by 50% and so reaches 30 minutes earlier on the usual trip. How many minutes does the trip take at the usual speed?
solution: For the same distance, time is multiplied by 100/150 = 2/3, saving 1/3 of the usual time. 1/3 × T = 30, so T = 90 minutes.

solutionHi: उतनी ही दूरी के लिए समय 100/150 = 2/3 से गुणा होता है, यानी सामान्य समय का 1/3 बचता है। 1/3 × T = 30, अतः T = 90 मिनट।
